from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's filing regarding accounts receivable."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this filing belongs to")
    filing_period: str | None = Field(description="The period the financial data covers, e.g., 'March 31, 2024'")
    has_accounts_receivable: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the company reports any accounts receivable balance")
    accounts_receivable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The accounts receivable amount as reported; None if not reported or zero")
    accounts_receivable_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    balance_sheet_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label from the balance sheet as written")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt containing the accounts receivable figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
